title: Email/copy args
description: Arguments for Email/copy (RFC 8621 §5.7 / RFC 8620 §5.4). Copies emails between accounts.

fromAccountId.description: The account to copy emails from.

ifFromInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard on the source Email state.

accountId.description: The account to copy emails into.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard on the destination Email state.

create.description: Map of client-assigned creation ids to objects describing the copy.

id.description: The id of the Email in the source account.

mailboxIds.description: Map of Mailbox id to true in the destination account.

keywords.description: Keywords to set on the copied email.

onSuccessDestroyOriginal.description: If true, destroy original emails on success. Default: false.

destroyFromIfInState.description: Guard on source state when destroying originals.
